name: Secure Electronic Technology Plc (SET Plc)
source: Secure Electronic Technology Plc, NGX ticker NSLTECH and also listed by the board as SET Plc. Audited financial statements for the year ended 31 December 2025, held in the NGX disclosure library. The filing is a scan with no text layer, so every figure was read from it by OCR at 200 dpi on 25 September 2026, and each printed identity was checked before the rows were written | key alias copy from NSLTECH, the same security under the code the issuer filing is headed with

rows.label: Operating Expenses
rows.note: printed other operating expenses line, stored positive; gross profit less this line does not equal the printed operating result because other operating income and other operating gains sit above it in the statement

rows.label: Net Finance Costs
rows.note: printed finance costs, stored negative by the convention of this file

rows.label: Income Tax
rows.note: stored negative, so profit before tax plus this row equals the printed total comprehensive loss for the year in both periods

rows.label: Net Profit
rows.note: printed total comprehensive loss for the year, the figure this file also carried before the rebuild

rows.label: EPS
rows.note: carried over from the audited summary that supplied this row before the rebuild; the pages read by OCR did not include the earnings per share line, and the net loss over the 5,631,540,540 shares in issue puts basic earnings at 0.03 naira of loss per share

note: Rebuilt 25 September 2026 from the audited FY2025 report of the issuer, statement of profit or loss page 20. Every row is a printed figure and the printed identities tie in both years: revenue less cost of sales equals the printed gross profit, and loss before taxation plus the taxation charge equals the printed total comprehensive loss. Figures are in naira, the reporting currency of the issuer, stored absolute rather than in thousands. This replaced a four row summary from a secondary feed that carried revenue, net profit and earnings per share only; those figures were revenue 4,240,000,000 and 4,000,000 against a net loss of 166,800,000 and 121,000,000, consistent with the filing at that summary rounding.
derivedCellsNote: Rows tagged derived are arithmetic on the printed inputs of this file, each with its formula.
aliasNote: Published under the other board code of this security as well: the NGX board carries it as NSLTECH while the issuer filing is headed SET Plc, so the row resolves only when the statement exists under the code a lookup asks for.
